info.title: barcode-service
info.summary: Durable box-scan ingest with a server-authoritative, gapless per-production-order label sequence.
info.description:
Phase-0 box-scan write API. Every write for one production order runs in a single Postgres transaction under a per-PO advisory lock, so the `production` label sequence is dense (1,2,3,...) with no gaps or duplicates even under concurrent scanners or client retries. `scan_uuid` is a client-generated idempotency key: replaying an accepted scan returns the original row with `replayed: true` and writes nothing.

Tenancy: the client never names a tenant. `id_enterprise` is derived server-side from the verified JWT (Cognito `custom:id_enterprise` claim, or a users-table lookup for a Firebase uid) and every write is fenced by it.

Deployment: staging only. The service is not defined in the production compose file, so there is no production server. The public `scan.<domain>` vhost proxies only the exact paths `/v1/scans`, `/v1/scans/stream` and `/healthz`; this document (`/openapi.json`) is reachable only in-network.

Ops routes not described here: `GET /healthz` (503 when the DB is unreachable) and `GET /metrics` (Phase-0 placeholder).

## How to call this API

- **Auth**: every operation needs `Authorization: Bearer <cognito-id-token>` (or a Firebase ID token while the Firebase → Cognito migration runs). The tenant comes from the token, never from the request. Every auth failure is the same generic 401, so the response never says which check failed.
- **Base URLs**: see `servers` — the public staging host `https://scan.staging.packiot.app` for scanner clients, the in-network address for services on packiot-net, and `http://localhost:8446` for local development. There is no production deployment yet.
- **Content types**: request bodies are `application/json` (max 64 KiB, unknown fields rejected). `POST /v1/scans` answers `application/json`; `GET /v1/scans/stream` answers `text/event-stream`.
- **Errors**: handler errors are `application/json` bodies `{"error":"<code>"}` with a stable machine code (plus `expected`/`got` on `label_seq_gap`). The 401 from the auth middleware is written with Go's `http.Error`, so it is served as `text/plain; charset=utf-8` even though its body text is JSON, with a trailing newline. A wrong HTTP method on a known path is a 405 from Go's router (`text/plain`, `Method Not Allowed`, with an `Allow` header), returned before authentication.
- **Docs**: browse this spec in the API docs portal at https://api.staging.packiot.app/docs/ (behind the cs-admin SSO, read-only Swagger UI). It is also exported to `docs/api/openapi/barcode-service.openapi.json` in packiot-stack-alpha.

servers.description: Staging public host (nginx exact-path proxy; JWT is the only gate)

tags.name: scans
tags.description: Box-scan write path (`POST /v1/scans`) and its live per-production-order fan-out (`GET /v1/scans/stream`). Writes land in `box_scans` and the per-PO counter `po_box_counter`.

post.description:
Records one scanned box against a production order.

**Order of checks**: bearer token (401) → JSON body ≤ 64 KiB with no unknown fields (400 `invalid json body`) → field validation (400 with a code) → then, inside ONE transaction holding `pg_advisory_xact_lock(id_production_order)`: idempotent replay by `scan_uuid` (200) → tenant fence on the production order AND the equipment (403 `tenant_mismatch`) → label allocation/validation (`validate` mode: 400 `label_seq_required` / 409 `label_seq_gap`) → insert.

**Side effects** (only on 201): inserts one row into `box_scans` (with `id_site`, `id_area`, `id_order` copied from the tenant's own equipment and production-order rows) and upserts `po_box_counter` (`last_label_seq` high-water mark, `total_qty += qty` for `production` scans). The accepted result is then pushed to every `GET /v1/scans/stream` subscriber of the same PO and tenant.

**Label sequence**: only `production` scans consume a label and count toward `total`; `sample`, `void`, `reprint` and `rework` are stored with no label (`label_seq` 0 in the response) and do not change the total.

**Idempotency**: `scan_uuid` is UNIQUE. Re-sending an accepted `scan_uuid` returns 200 with `replayed: true`, the original `box_scan_id` and `label_seq`, and the PO's *current* `total`; nothing is written and nothing is streamed. Retry on any network error or 500 with the same `scan_uuid`.

**Tenant scoping**: the tenant is the token's `id_enterprise`. A production order or equipment of another tenant, or one that does not exist, is 403 `tenant_mismatch`.

**Limits**: body ≤ 64 KiB. No rate limit; writes for the same PO are serialized by the advisory lock.

requestBody.description: One scan. Max 64 KiB. Unknown fields are rejected (400 `invalid json body`). There is no tenant field: the tenant comes only from the token.

assign.summary: Production box, server assigns the next label

validate.summary: Pre-printed label: the client asserts label 8

minimal.summary: Minimal body (qty 1, production, assign by default)

sample.summary: Quality sample: recorded, no label, not counted

201.description: Scan accepted and written (`box_scans` row + `po_box_counter` update), and pushed to stream subscribers.

200.description: Idempotent replay: `scan_uuid` was already accepted. The original `box_scan_id` and `label_seq` are returned with the PO's current `total` and `replayed: true`; nothing is written or streamed.

400.description: Malformed JSON, a body over 64 KiB, or an unknown field (`invalid json body`); or a validation code: `scan_uuid_required`, `id_production_order_required`, `id_equipment_required`, `qty_invalid` (negative qty), `scan_type_invalid`, `mode_invalid`, `label_seq_required` (`validate` mode for a `production` scan without `label_seq`; checked inside the transaction, after the tenant fence).

403.description: `tenant_mismatch`: the production order or the equipment does not exist or does not belong to the caller's tenant. Nothing is written.

409.description: `label_seq_gap` (`validate` mode): the asserted `label_seq` is not the next label. `expected` is the server's next label and `got` is what was sent (`got` is omitted when the client sent 0, because the field is `omitempty`). Nothing is written; re-sync and retry with the expected label.

500.description: Infrastructure failure (`record failed`): database unreachable, commit failure, or a concurrent duplicate `scan_uuid` hitting the UNIQUE constraint. The transaction is rolled back; retrying with the same `scan_uuid` is safe.

get.summary: Live feed of accepted scans for one order
get.description:
Long-lived Server-Sent Events stream. Sends the comment `: connected` on open, then one `event: scan` frame per accepted (201) scan of the requested production order whose `data:` line is a `ScanResult` JSON object, plus a `: heartbeat` comment every 25 s so proxies keep the connection open.

**Tenant scoping**: only scans written under the caller's tenant are delivered; knowing another tenant's PO id yields an empty (heartbeat-only) stream, not an error. The PO id is not checked for existence.

**Delivery**: best-effort and at-most-once. Each subscriber has a 16-event buffer; when it is full, new events for that subscriber are dropped rather than slowing the write path. Replays (200) are not re-published. There is no resume/`Last-Event-ID` support and no history: the durable record is `box_scans`. The fan-out is in-memory in a single replica; the stream ends when the service shuts down.

**Side effects**: none (read-only).

parameters.name: id_production_order
parameters.description: Production order to subscribe to (positive integer).

200.description: Event stream (`Cache-Control: no-cache`). Each `event: scan` frame's `data:` line is a JSON `ScanResult`; lines starting with `:` are comments (connect / heartbeat).

schema.description: SSE frames separated by a blank line.

400.description: `id_production_order` missing, not an integer, or not positive.

500.description: `streaming unsupported`: the response writer cannot flush (not expected behind the stack's nginx; defensive).

bearerAuth.description: `Authorization: Bearer <ID token>`. The issuer is read from the token's `iss` and routed to the matching verifier: an Amazon Cognito user-pool token (tenant from the signed `custom:id_enterprise` claim; `aud` checked when COGNITO_CLIENT_ID is set) or a Firebase ID token (tenant looked up in `users` by `id_user_firebase`, active users only). Either verifier is enabled only when configured. Any unknown issuer, invalid token or unresolved tenant is a generic 401.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed or unverifiable bearer token, unknown issuer, or no tenant could be derived (including a failed users-table lookup for a Firebase uid). Written with `http.Error`, so the Content-Type is `text/plain; charset=utf-8` even though the body text is JSON (with a trailing newline).

MethodNotAllowed.description: Wrong HTTP method for this path. Produced by Go's router before authentication; carries an `Allow` header naming the supported method.

ScanRequest.description: One box scan. No tenant field: the tenant comes only from the JWT.

scan_uuid.description: Client-generated idempotency key, globally UNIQUE (a UUID is recommended). Re-sending it returns the original result.

raw_barcode.description: Raw scanned barcode text, stored as-is (GS1 parsing is Phase 2). Optional.

id_production_order.description: Production order the scan belongs to; must belong to the caller's tenant.

id_equipment.description: Scanning station (equipment id); must belong to the caller's tenant.

qty.description: Units on the box. 0 or absent means 1; negative is rejected (`qty_invalid`).

scan_type.description: Case-insensitive. Only `production` consumes a label and counts toward the total.

mode.description: Case-insensitive. `assign`: the server allocates the next label. `validate`: the client asserts `label_seq`, which must equal the server's next label (else 409).

label_seq.description: Required in `validate` mode for `production` scans; ignored otherwise.

ScanResult.description: The accepted (or replayed) scan; also the `data:` payload of stream events.

total.description: Running total quantity of `production` scans for the PO (on a replay: the current total, not the total at the original write).

scan_uuid.description: Echo of the request's idempotency key.

replayed.description: true when this is an idempotent replay and nothing new was written.

error.description: Stable machine code or short message.

expected.description: `label_seq_gap` only: the next label the server would allocate.

got.description: `label_seq_gap` only: the label the client asserted (omitted when 0).
